results.name: actor_build_order_default
results.evidence: Zeroes a 92-byte record via the EDX out-pointer, writes a 0xffff target sentinel and a code word taken from CX (forced to 0 when the actor's busy/dead flag at actor+6 is set); matches the zero-then-populate 'order' pattern shared by the other FUN_004xxxxx builders that feed actor_process_order_request.
results.summary: Builds a default/idle actor order record (zeroed body, 0xffff target) that is cleared out if the actor is currently unable to act.

results.name: actor_cycle_formation_position
results.evidence: Looks up the actor's unit-type definition (index*0xe8 into a per-type table), scans a squad's position/seat list (stride 0x50) for slots free of nearby occupants and matching team byte, then advances/retreats through that list depending on param_1 (1..5), matching FUN_00432100 for the mode-5 random pick.
results.summary: Selects the next, previous, or a random free formation/firing position for the actor from its unit type's position list, skipping slots already claimed by nearby squadmates.

results.name: actor_pathfind_refresh_if_needed
results.evidence: If actor+0x4c ('needs path') is set it zeroes a large scratch buffer, tags the request header with type 6 and calls FUN_00413e50/FUN_00414060 (the pathfinding request/commit pair reused across this file), then reports whether the resulting distance field at actor+0x280 is zero.
results.summary: Issues a pathfinding request for the actor when its 'needs new path' flag is set and returns whether the computed path reaches the destination exactly.

results.name: actor_consider_combat_mode
results.evidence: Branches on a mode selector (param_2 in {0,2,3,4,5}), consults morale/vitality state, calls the wait-timer getter FUN_004028e0, the LOS/fire helper FUN_004029e0 and FUN_00417910/FUN_00417a30 (fire-permission toggles), and fills an output order buffer (param_3) with the chosen sub-order and firing pattern before returning a go/no-go bool; this result feeds actor_evaluate_combat_state_transition (0x40c620).
results.summary: Evaluates whether the actor should switch to a new combat sub-mode (grenade, search, guard, engage) and, if so, fills in the resulting order parameters.

results.name: actor_get_reaction_wait_time
results.evidence: Returns a float10 threshold selected by an implicit mode register (in_CX in {0,2,3,4}), reading either a cluster-derived 'search wait' field (offset 0x37c/0x388) or, via FUN_00428370, a vitality-based value (offset 0x608), always clamped to be non-negative.
results.summary: Computes the wait/reaction-time threshold the actor should use for its current consideration mode (search wait vs vitality-based delay).

results.name: actor_request_grenade_impact_trace
results.evidence: Chooses a source point (either a cached position at actor+0x120 or a freshly looked-up one via FUN_00569190) and passes the offset to the target point (unaff_ESI) into FUN_00505880 with request code 0x33, the pattern used elsewhere in this module for line/impact traces.
results.summary: Issues a trace request from a cached or newly fetched source point toward a target point, used when evaluating a grenade throw.

results.name: actor_lookup_command_range
results.evidence: Indexes a 100-byte-stride command table (DAT_008802d4) to get a per-type index, then reads a float (offset 0x28) and a datum handle (offset 0x10) out of a 0x74-byte type-definition array (DAT_00746f8c+0x46c), packing them into a caller-supplied 5-dword record with -1 sentinels when the float is zero.
results.summary: Fetches a range/threshold value and an associated datum handle from an actor-type definition table entry for a given command index, filling caller-provided output fields.

results.name: actor_schedule_grenade_throw
results.evidence: Requires a live grenade-throw target (actor+0x1dc/0x1e0), resolves it via FUN_0043ea80, computes a delay scaled by morale/target-shield checks and random_real_range against per-type parameters (offset 0xd4/0xd8), then writes the pending-throw state (type=8, sub=5, delay, target) into actor+0x544..0x558.
results.summary: Once a grenade target has been resolved, computes a randomized throw delay and records a pending grenade-throw order on the actor.

results.name: actor_evaluate_new_destination
results.evidence: Gates on actor+0x4c ('needs destination'); when the target is unseen (offset 0x160) it issues a pathfinding request (header type 0) via FUN_00413e50/FUN_00414060 and, if the new node differs from the cached one, rolls a random search wait; otherwise it re-evaluates LOS via FUN_00429620/FUN_00412960 and morale (offset 0x268) before deciding whether to move.
results.summary: Decides whether the actor needs a new movement destination based on target visibility and morale, and if so issues a pathfinding request for one.

results.name: actor_build_order_grenade_or_melee
results.evidence: Zeroes a 24-word order buffer, sets a code word from param_2/param_3/param_4 and a target handle from in_EAX, has a ~40% chance (LCG against DAT_00719cd0) of forcing a 'throw' sub-code (0x2d) for codes 9..12 (matching actor_is_grenade_type), and otherwise falls through to the melee-path evaluator FUN_00403f00 when the actor is alive.
results.summary: Builds a grenade-throw-or-melee order for the actor, randomly biasing toward a grenade throw for certain order codes and otherwise checking for a valid melee attack.

results.name: actor_can_perceive_last_known_target
results.evidence: Requires a valid target unit (actor+0x34) and last-seen slot (actor+0x3b8); compares squared distance to the actor's field-of-view radius from FUN_00429620, short-circuiting true if a squad-mate (actor+0xb8) already has a matching or unresolved combat-status type.
results.summary: Returns whether the actor still perceives its last known target position as within engagement range, accounting for a leading squadmate's status.

results.name: actor_evaluate_melee_path
results.evidence: Builds a pathfinding request (header via FUN_00412880/FUN_00412ba0/FUN_00414060) toward the current melee target's weapon-marker offsets (0xf0/0xf4/0xf8/0xec) and, on success, calls FUN_0043a8b0/FUN_0043a220 to validate the attack, storing the resulting path distance and an obstruction flag back into the caller's order record (unaff_EBX[4]/[0x10]).
results.summary: Computes a path to the actor's melee target and validates whether the melee attack is currently reachable, recording distance and obstruction results.

results.name: actor_evaluate_weapon_pickup_path
results.evidence: Validates a candidate weapon-holder record (param_1: unit index +0x1c, seat +8), plays a pickup-related sound via FUN_00569190, asks FUN_0042b270 whether the path to that seat's marker is clear, and on success copies the marker position into the record (offset 0x24..0x2c).
results.summary: Checks whether the actor can path to and pick up a weapon held by another unit, copying the target position into the record on success.

results.name: actor_order_code_is_grenade_throw
results.evidence: Trivial range check `8 < in_AX && in_AX < 0xd`, i.e. order codes 9..12; the identical inline check (8 < param_2 && param_2 < 0xd) appears in actor_build_order_grenade_or_melee (0x403630) selecting the grenade sub-code.
results.summary: Returns whether an order code (passed in AX) falls in the grenade-throw code range 9-12.

results.name: actor_build_order_return_to_post
results.evidence: Zeroes a 17-dword order record then copies the actor's anchor/home position (actor+0x174/0x178/0x17c) into the order's position fields, sets its type word to 1 and a target sentinel of 0xffff, matching the pattern of the other order-builder helpers.
results.summary: Builds an order that sends the actor back to its anchor/home position.

results.name: actor_build_order_guard_post
results.evidence: Same zero-and-populate order pattern as 0x4044b0, but branches on an unaff_BX value: zero means a plain 'idle at current spot' order, non-zero copies the actor's anchor position (offset 0x174..0x17c) as a guard destination, both with -1 target sentinels.
results.summary: Builds a stationary guard order, either at the actor's current position or at its designated anchor point.

results.name: actor_build_order_search_wait
results.evidence: Bails out (0xffffff00) when morale (offset 0x15e) is 4; otherwise, if not busy/dead, reads a scenario search-position handle (offset 0x1e8) and derives a wait-duration scale from a per-target-category switch (offset 0x1e4-6, values 6/40000000, 1/2/3f800000, 3/3fc00000) before calling FUN_0041f3a0 and populating order fields with the target's marker transform.
results.summary: Builds a search-and-wait order at a scenario search position, scaling the wait duration by target category, unless morale has broken.

results.name: actor_build_order_random_look
results.evidence: Picks a random look angle via random_real_range from either 'combat' (offset 0x29c/0x298) or 'idle' (offset 0x2d4/0x2d0) angle ranges depending on an alert flag (unaff_EBX+0xc), or, when an explicit look target is supplied (unaff_EBX+0x20), computes and normalizes the direction vector to it via vector3d_normalize_with_length.
results.summary: Builds an order making the actor look in a randomly chosen direction, or at an explicit target point when one is supplied.

results.name: actor_report_command_list_status
results.evidence: Skips if already reported (actor+0xa2), otherwise maps the scenario command-list index (offset 0x1e4, values 1..10) to a fixed chatter/status id (0x30..0x38) and, for a target with a resolved shield/vitality state, forwards it through FUN_0042d340 along with a shield-tier code derived via FUN_0045bdb0.
results.summary: Reports the actor's scripted command-list status as a chatter/status event keyed by command index and target shield state, once per actor.

results.name: actor_pathfind_move_and_face
results.evidence: Bails when the actor is dead/target-invisible (offsets 6/0x160, sets a 0xffff sub-order); otherwise, once its move-request flags (0x4c/0xaa) are set, cancels a stale 'in transit' state, issues a pathfinding request (header type 4) via FUN_00412880/FUN_00412ba0/FUN_00414060, and rolls a new random wait timer (offset 0x9c) from random_real_range.
results.summary: Issues a move-and-face pathfinding request for the actor and schedules a follow-up random wait once the move completes.

results.name: vector3d_cross_product
results.evidence: Computes the classic 3D cross product (b.z*a.y-a.z*b.y, a.z*b.x-a.x*b.z, a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x) between two register-passed vectors into an output pointer.
results.summary: Computes the cross product of two 3D vectors (registers in_EAX=out, param_1=a, in_ECX=b).

results.name: random_int_range
results.evidence: Advances the LCG state DAT_00719cd0 and returns `((param_1-in_ECX) * (rand>>16) >> 16) + in_ECX`, the standard fixed-point 'random integer between in_ECX and param_1' idiom paired with the already-named random_real_range float variant used throughout this module.
results.summary: Returns a pseudo-random integer linearly interpolated between an implicit lower bound (ECX) and param_1.

results.name: float_compare_ascending
results.evidence: Standard three-way float comparator (-1/0/1) that FUN_00405520 passes directly to _qsort to sort candidate scores.
results.summary: qsort comparator that orders two floats ascending by the values they point to.

results.name: actor_get_body_axis_vector
results.evidence: Selects between the actor's cached facing vector (offset 0x174..0x17c) or one looked up via FUN_00569720, then returns it, its negation, or a perpendicular axis obtained via vector3d_cross_product/vector3d_normalize_with_length depending on a 0..3 axis selector at in_ECX+8.
results.summary: Returns one of the actor's four body-relative axis vectors (forward, back, or a perpendicular pair) for use in aiming/orientation math.

results.name: actor_squad_action_execute
results.evidence: Dispatches on the type field of a 0x20-byte entry pulled from a squad's action-list reflexive (indexed by the actor's current action index, count/base at squad+0x30/+0x34), with case bodies that throw grenades, aim/look at a point or object, set actor flags, wait on random or distance-based conditions, etc.; the same 0x20-byte entry layout and array is checked for completion by actor_squad_action_is_complete (0x4066d0).
results.summary: Executes the squad's current scripted action-list entry for this actor, branching on the entry's action type (aim, look, grenade, flag set, proximity wait, ...).

results.name: actor_squad_action_is_complete
results.evidence: Reads the same per-squad 0x20-byte action-list entry (indexed by *param_3) as actor_squad_action_execute and, per action type, tests whether its completion condition now holds (distance thresholds, target facing, morale level, shield state) before actor_squad_action_list_process advances to the next entry.
results.summary: Tests whether the actor's current squad action-list entry has finished, based on its action type's completion condition.

results.name: actor_squad_action_reset
results.evidence: Switches on the same action entry type code used by the execute/is-complete pair and clears or reinitializes the associated per-entry state fields (e.g. clearing flag bits at unaff_EBX+5/8/9, or byte fields on param_2) when the list driver advances past the entry.
results.summary: Resets/cleans up per-entry state for the actor's current squad action-list item before moving to the next one.

results.name: actor_squad_action_list_process
results.evidence: Loops calling actor_squad_action_is_complete (FUN_004066d0) then, if not yet done, actor_squad_action_reset (FUN_00406c50) and actor_squad_action_execute (FUN_00405520), advancing the entry index each time, until the entry count for the squad (offset+0x30) is exhausted or an abort flag (param_4[4]&4) is set; sets *param_6=0 while still running.
results.summary: Drives a squad's scripted action list for this actor to completion, calling the per-entry check/reset/execute functions in sequence.

results.name: actor_squad_for_each_member
results.evidence: If the actor is busy/dead (offset+6) it walks a squad-member table (DAT_0088035c stride 0x98, DAT_00880358 stride 0x40) invoking the callback param_3 for each member (optionally clearing its 9 dwords of state first when param_2 is set); otherwise it calls param_3 once for the lone actor itself.
results.summary: Invokes a callback for every member of the actor's squad (or just the actor alone), optionally resetting each member's per-callback state first.

results.name: actor_squad_notify_member_changed
results.evidence: Validates a squad member index against the current zone/cluster (DAT_0069e8d8), packs several status bits from the member's type-definition flags (offset 0x20) into an output record, optionally calling FUN_00414560, and finishes by broadcasting to the squad via actor_squad_for_each_member (FUN_00407040) with callback LAB_00406dd0.
results.summary: Records a squad member's updated status bits and broadcasts the change to the rest of the squad.

results.name: actor_squad_broadcast_default
results.evidence: Thin wrapper that just calls actor_squad_for_each_member (FUN_00407040) with no explicit arguments, relying on the caller's register state.
results.summary: Convenience wrapper that forwards to actor_squad_for_each_member using the caller's register arguments.

results.name: actor_build_order_flee
results.evidence: Zeroes an 11-dword order record, and if the actor is not blind/unaware (offset 0x160==0) sets a bool flag from param_1, a -1 target sentinel, marks the actor as committed to an order (offset+0x98=1), and returns success.
results.summary: Builds a flee-style order for the actor and marks it as having committed to a new order.

results.name: actor_build_order_face_seat_marker
results.evidence: Zeroes an 11-dword order record and, when the actor has a live target unit (offset+0x34) and a valid seat index (param_1), copies that seat's marker transform (base array stride 0x18) and orientation short into the order, sets its type word to 1, and marks the actor committed (offset+0x98=1).
results.summary: Builds an order that has the actor face a specific seat marker on its target unit.

results.name: actor_build_order_stop
results.evidence: Zeroes an 11-dword order record and, only if the actor is dead/inactive (offset+6 != 0), sets its type word to 2 and marks the actor committed (offset+0x98=1).
results.summary: Builds a minimal 'stop/idle' order, only valid while the actor is inactive.

results.name: actor_build_order_wait
results.evidence: Zeroes a 13-dword order record and, when the actor is visible and alive (offsets 0x160 and 6 both zero), sets its type word to 0 and stores param_1 into a following byte field.
results.summary: Builds a simple wait order carrying a single caller-supplied byte parameter.

results.name: actor_build_order_face_seat_marker_ex
results.evidence: Same seat-marker copy and validity gating as actor_build_order_face_seat_marker (0x407820), but additionally clears an extra flag byte and sets a 'no-commit' byte instead of the actor+0x98 commit flag, indicating a variant used for evaluation rather than committing.
results.summary: Builds a face-seat-marker order like actor_build_order_face_seat_marker but without committing the actor to it.

results.name: actor_pathfind_query_grenade_arc
results.evidence: Gated on actor+0x4c/0x160/0x9d flags, this builds a pathfinding request (header type 3) that, when a grenade-arc mode is active (offset 0xa4==1), includes arc parameters (offsets 0xac..0xb8), then compares the returned node (sStack_10736) against a stored one (offset 0xa0/0xbc) to flag success/failure via FUN_00413e50/FUN_00414060.
results.summary: Issues a pathfinding query that optionally includes grenade-arc parameters and records whether the requested destination changed.

results.name: actor_build_order_search_object
results.evidence: Requires the actor idle and un-pinned (offset 0x158==-1, 6==0, type!=9), validates range with actor_is_within_alert_range (FUN_00408f30), finds a search waypoint via actor_find_best_search_position (FUN_00409070), checks visibility (FUN_00565150), computes an avoidance-adjusted destination via actor_compute_avoidance_offset (FUN_004095c0), and finally validates reachability with FUN_00417610 before returning success.
results.summary: Builds an order sending the actor to investigate a specific object, chaining range, waypoint, visibility, and reachability checks.

results.name: actor_build_order_investigate_encounter_point
results.evidence: Same waypoint/avoidance/reachability pipeline as actor_build_order_search_object, but the candidate is derived from the encounter cluster data (DAT_008603b0) and requires the cluster's vitality (offset 0x88 >= 0.5) and non-deaf flag before proceeding through actor_evaluate_search_position (FUN_004091d0), FUN_004095c0 and FUN_00417610.
results.summary: Builds an order sending the actor to investigate an encounter-derived point of interest, subject to vitality and perception checks.

results.name: actor_update_investigate_state
results.evidence: Refreshes a cached investigation anchor (offsets 0xac/0xb0..0xb8) roughly every 0x96 ticks using object_try_and_get and actor_is_within_alert_range (FUN_00408f30), repeatedly calls actor_evaluate_search_position (FUN_004091d0) to pick a new point, then commits via actor_compute_avoidance_offset (FUN_004095c0) and FUN_00417610, tracking failure counters (offset 0xa8/0xc6) that eventually call FUN_00566970 to abandon the search.
results.summary: Maintains and periodically advances the actor's 'investigating a disturbance' state, abandoning the search after too many failed attempts.

results.name: actor_is_within_alert_range
results.evidence: Computes squared distance from the actor to either a supplied point or object_get_position()'s result and compares it against a caller-supplied radius, gated by the unit's deaf/blind flag (byte+0x106 & 4) and requiring vitality (float+0x88) >= 0.5.
results.summary: Returns whether a point or object lies within a given alert radius of the actor, subject to the actor's perception and vitality state.

results.name: actor_find_best_search_position
results.evidence: Iterates a candidate list (count at cluster+0x2e4) calling actor_evaluate_search_position (FUN_004091d0) for each index and keeps the entry with the highest returned score (local_4c), returning its index and associated position/direction/orientation vectors.
results.summary: Scans a cluster's list of candidate search positions and returns the index and data for the highest-scoring one.

results.name: actor_evaluate_search_position
results.evidence: Walks a linked list of path/junction nodes (type field ==9) looking for one matching the requested from/to object pair and squared-distance tolerance, then computes a direction vector via vector2d_normalize_with_length and a facing angle, returning them plus a visibility-derived score through the output parameters.
results.summary: Evaluates one candidate search/junction node against a from-to object pair, returning its direction, orientation, and a visibility-based score.

results.name: actor_compute_avoidance_offset
results.evidence: Computes an offset destination that steers around an obstacle circle (radius/position from puVar1 fields, clamped by cluster offset 0x280) using perpendicular-vector math and vector2d_normalize_with_length, then raycasts the resulting point onto the ground via FUN_00502060 to produce a final walkable point.
results.summary: Adjusts a destination point to avoid a nearby obstacle and projects the result onto the ground via a ray cast.

results.name: actor_build_order_wait_random
results.evidence: Zeroes a 6-dword order record and, when the actor is visible (offset 0x160==0), copies its vitality category byte, stores the caller's code (param_1), stamps the current game time (DAT_006f1d6c+0xc), sets type word 0x78, and rolls a random wait duration of 300 + rand%300 ticks via the LCG at DAT_00719cd0.
results.summary: Builds a wait order with a randomized duration between roughly 300 and 600 ticks.

results.name: actor_invoke_type_handler
results.evidence: Looks up a function-pointer table (&DAT_00655268, stride 0x38) indexed by the actor's behavior-type field (offset+0x6c) and calls the entry if non-null, i.e. a virtual dispatch by AI archetype.
results.summary: Invokes the type-specific AI handler function for the actor's current behavior type, if one is registered.

results.name: actor_process_order_request
results.evidence: Central switch on an order code (param_2, defaulting from actor+0x60/0x62 when 0xffff), throttled by a per-actor last-request timestamp (offset+100) and a per-code cooldown table (DAT_00655590); each case calls one of the order-builder helpers in this file (actor_build_order_default, actor_build_order_return_to_post, actor_build_order_guard_post, actor_decide_combat_action, ...) and commits the result via order-dispatch FUN_0040d8d0.
results.summary: Central dispatcher that turns a requested order code into a concrete built order for the actor, subject to per-code cooldowns.

results.name: actor_check_traversal_cooldown
results.evidence: Compares a traversal/jump counter (offset+0x308) against param_1, resets it when fleeing (type==4) and a pending value (offset+0xa8) is set, enforces a 7-tick cooldown against the last-traversal time (offset+0x398), optionally plays a scripted chatter/animation (FUN_0042d340, id 0x22) when exceeding param_3, and otherwise defers to FUN_0040de20.
results.summary: Gates whether the actor may perform a jump/climb-style traversal action, applying a per-actor cooldown and a scripted animation trigger.

results.name: actor_wants_weapon_swap_or_reload
results.evidence: Returns true when the actor's ammo/reload timers (offset 0x90/0x92) are pending, or when its squad's shared low-ammo counter (looked up via DAT_008802c8/DAT_008802cc) is positive and morale (offset+0x6e) hasn't degraded past 5 (else it notifies via FUN_00439270); also forces true for vehicle-type actors (offset+0x6c==0xb) that aren't currently suppressed.
results.summary: Returns whether the actor currently wants to reload or swap weapons, based on ammo state, squad-wide low-ammo signaling, and morale.

results.name: actor_unit_eject_from_seat
results.evidence: Handles moving a biped between a vehicle seat and standalone existence: locates the owning object via object_try_and_get, transforms a seat marker with matrix4x3_multiply, updates seat/occupant bookkeeping fields (puVar13[0xc9..0xcc], [0x1d..0x22]), calls object_for_each_light_attachment and object_recalculate_bounding_radius_recursive, and records multiplayer respawn/kill-in-seat state via datum_get.
results.summary: Detaches or re-seats an actor's controlled unit relative to a vehicle seat, updating seat, transform, and multiplayer bookkeeping as needed.

results.name: actor_should_throw_grenade
results.evidence: Evaluates a chain of grenade-eligibility gates: a recent-charge distance/time window using FUN_006391b4, combat-status thresholds (offset+0x6e vs 7), morale/vitality comparisons against per-type fields (offset 0x324/0x2d8), and finally rejects if already flagged as recently thrown (offset+0x378) or not visible (offset+0x160), matching the scheduling function actor_schedule_grenade_throw (0x402f80).
results.summary: Returns whether the actor is currently eligible to throw a grenade, based on cooldowns, combat status, and vitality thresholds.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_reaction
results.evidence: Reacts to nearby thrown grenades (count/index at offset 0x3a8/0x3ac) by calling actor_should_throw_grenade (FUN_0040b840) and dodge helpers FUN_0040dd50/FUN_0040de20, and independently monitors a panic/morale timer (offset+0x354) to trigger flee dialogue/animation via FUN_0040dc30/FUN_0040de70/FUN_0042d340 when it expires.
results.summary: Periodically checks for nearby grenade threats and expiring morale timers, triggering dodge or flee reactions as needed.

results.name: actor_evaluate_combat_state_transition
results.evidence: Checks target visibility/LOS timers and squad-role conditions (offsets 0x6c/0xa0/0x270), calls actor_consider_combat_mode (FUN_00401a60) with mode 2 or 4 depending on context, and on success commits the resulting order via order-dispatch FUN_0040d8d0 with code 10 (full combat/alert).
results.summary: Decides whether the actor should transition into full combat/alert state and, if so, commits the corresponding order.

results.name: actor_get_target_state_flags
results.evidence: Clears a set of caller-supplied boolean output flags (param_5..param_10) based on transition codes (in_AX/in_CX/param_2 in {1,2}) and the target unit's shield-broken bits (offset+0xb9/0xba), invoking FUN_00412960 for a deeper shield-recharge check, and forces flags off for target-invalid, low-morale, or dead-target conditions.
results.summary: Computes a set of target-state flags (shields down, morale-gated, target invalid) used by the combat decision routines.

results.name: actor_decide_melee_or_combat_action
results.evidence: Large decision tree that checks a per-type behavior table (DAT_00655258 indexed by offset+0x6c), melee-charge eligibility (actor_build_order_wait via FUN_004045a0), grenade throw thresholds, and pathfinding results (FUN_00412880/FUN_00412ba0/FUN_00414060) to pick between charge, retreat, wait, and face-target actions, committing the chosen one through order-dispatch FUN_0040d8d0.
results.summary: Chooses and commits the actor's next melee/close-combat action (charge, retreat, wait, or reposition) based on its behavior type and target state.

results.name: actor_flee_look_away
results.evidence: If the actor is in flee mode (offset+0x6c==4) and a look-away flag (offset+0xab) is set, it builds a random-look order via actor_build_order_random_look (FUN_004046c0) and commits it through order-dispatch FUN_0040d8d0.
results.summary: While fleeing, makes the actor look away from the threat by committing a randomized-look order.

results.name: actor_should_hold_combat_status
results.evidence: If the actor's command-list restriction (offset+0xa4) is active, compares its morale (offset+0x6e) directly against param_2; otherwise it holds the actor back when a squad grenade-alert counter (offset+0x9c) is positive and morale is below param_1, unless the scenario command index (offset+0x1e4/0xa1) overrides it.
results.summary: Determines whether the actor should stay at its current combat status level rather than escalating, based on morale and scripted command restrictions.

results.name: actor_command_list_allows_alert
results.evidence: Looks up a per-command-type flags word from a table indexed via the target's command-list handle (DAT_008802d4/DAT_00746f8c), then checks its bits against the actor's current morale (offset+0x268) and a scenario override flag (offset+0x1f6) to decide whether escalation to a higher combat status is scripted-permitted.
results.summary: Checks whether the scenario's scripted command-list settings permit the actor to escalate to a higher alert/combat status.

results.name: actor_run_type_combat_behavior
results.evidence: Dispatches on the actor's behavior-type table entry (DAT_00655258 indexed by offset+0x6c, values 1..4) between actor_evaluate_combat_state_transition (FUN_0040c620) and actor_decide_melee_or_combat_action (FUN_0040cdf0), gated by morale thresholds (offset+0x6e) and target shield/visibility state, falling back to the melee/combat decision when the primary check declines.
results.summary: Runs the combat-behavior update appropriate to the actor's archetype, choosing between the state-transition check and the melee/combat decision logic.

results.name: actor_maybe_run_combat_state_transition
results.evidence: Only when the actor is already in combat state 10 with a matching sub-state (offset+0xa0 in {2,3} needing offset+0xa3/0xa4 clear, or {4,5} needing offset+0xc5 set) does it call actor_evaluate_combat_state_transition (FUN_0040c620); otherwise it is a no-op.
results.summary: Conditionally re-runs the combat state-transition check, but only while the actor is already in the relevant combat sub-state.
